findings.observation: All 100 puzzles have an identical given_count of 40 (min=max=40). The generator does not implement a givens gradient even when params specify givens_progression=true. The progression is flat within the easy tier. For a senior-large-print single-tier easy book, uniform difficulty is acceptable and may be preferable (predictable experience for seniors). The content_plan declares difficulty_progression=progressive; this is best interpreted as section-order progression (puzzles before solutions) rather than a within-tier difficulty gradient.
